t: The Chat Box peripheral allows you to interact with the game chat by sending and receiving messages.$(p)You can even send messages that are only visible for the Chat Box if you start your message with a `$`.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/chat_box/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
聊天方块外设允许你通过收发消息的方式与游戏聊天系统交互。$(p)你甚至可以发送仅对聊天方块可见的消息——只需在消息开头添加一个“$”符号即可。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/chat_box/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Chat Box to a computer to make use of it!
将你的聊天方块连接至计算机即可使用！
